content:
ellie: Heads-up — saw an unexpected uplift in EU signups after the Pro Lite launch. Dashboard shows GPU-hours spiking ~2.6x vs forecast in the last 6h. Can infra confirm headroom? :eyes:

sam: On it. Pulling capacity snapshot now. Quick Q — is this concentrated in one region or across eu-west/eu-central?

ellie: Mostly eu-west1 and eu-central1. EU fallback routing to us-west not kicking in fast enough for long-running sessions.

jordan: Checking fleet: current alloc vs cap for inference pools (A100-40GB / H100-80GB). Quick numbers:
- eu-west1: allocated 182 GPUs, used 167, pending scale requests 18
- eu-central1: allocated 120, used 114, pending scale requests 12
Pending scale stuck because some boot images failed post-update.

mira: I see the failed boot jobs in the provisioning queue — kernel module build for the new runtime failed on a subset of H100s. Logs:
```
[2026-03-18T08:12Z] module build error: NVML version mismatch
```
Retrying image push now.

devon: If kernel build retries finish in ~10-20m, autoscaler will clear. Short term we should shift new Pro Lite sessions to ondemand A100 pool in eu-west1 that still has spare slots. Can we patch routing? :thinking_face:

sam: Routing tweak is low-risk. I'll open a temporary rule to prefer ondemand-a100 for requests with tier=pro-lite and session_len < 60m. Will monitor latency.

ops-bot: autoscale: triggered 2x scale-up in eu-west1 (queue depth > 30). ETA for new nodes 12m.

jordan: Note — we also hit a network egress cap in one coloc due to an older quota config. Need to raise egress quota with the provider or route some telemetry through our CDN. That is delaying a few containers during startup.

mira: Can we short-circuit telemetry for startup bundles? We can make the first boot skip heavy telemetry to reduce egress.

devon: Agreed. Temporary config change: set TELEMETRY_STARTUP=off for pro-lite pool. Also will enable aggressive KV prefix caching for repeated prompts — should reduce token compute by ~8-12% for common prompts.

ellie: Sounds good. Any user-facing mitigation we should do? A quick rate-limit for new signups to smooth rollout?

sam: Propose soft ramp: enforce 2x smaller concurrency cap for pro-lite for the next 3h and then ramp to normal if metrics stable. I can push the PR and a fast rollback toggle.

ellie: Do it. Communicate to growth so they don't push more promos.

jordan: After kernel push completes and autoscale finishes, forecast for next 24h (with current signups) looks like ~18% extra GPU-hours vs baseline; if we don't throttle growth, could be up to ~40% by tomorrow morning.

mira: I'll keep watching the boot queue and NVML errors. If they recur, we should rollback runtime patch to previous image.

devon: Implemented telemetry flag and KV cache tweak. Patching routing now. I'll post rollout status in 10m.

sam: PR up for soft-ramp rate limit: #4523 — toggle 'pro_lite_soft_ramp' enabled. Monitoring metrics (concurrency, lat, failures).

ellie: Thanks all. Logging this thread for postmortem if the kernel issue recurs. :memo: Keep updates here only.
